ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) central and lower regions versus 35% high-intensity (white/cream) distal regions on both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones occupying the distal third of each lobe; the left lobe distal tip contains a high-intensity yellowish-brown focal staining. The central axis and lower regions are characterized by a solid black base layer heavily overlaid with high-intensity linear white artifacts.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree angle; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; multiple micro-notches present, including a prominent U-shaped indentation on the right lobe approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly spherical pixel groupings (barnacle colonization) localized on the leading edges and extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, multi-directional network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the central black regions, with several long horizontal scars crossing the vertical axis of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel-line scarring (rake marks) across the lower-central region and barnacle encrustations on the lobe perimeters.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown pixel cluster (likely diatom colonization) localized on the white region of the left lobe.
